toilet_paper_holder.method: OpenCV holder-line angle relative to separated local structural-reference lines
toilet_paper_holder.interpretation: The sagging holder is consistently more than 10 degrees below local cabinet/countertop reference geometry, while the clean holder remains within about 3.2 degrees.

toilet_base.visual_observation: A light caulk/sealant trace is visible around portions of the toilet base perimeter, particularly in the 2s and 3s selected frames.
current_opencv_result: Low-saturation light mask merges the ceramic toilet and light caulk/sealant evidence.
Canny edge evidence is heavily contaminated by wood-floor grain.
The current method does not consistently isolate a distinct second contour representing the old caulk footprint.
toilet_base.conclusion: Do not create a deterministic toilet-displacement rule from the current mask/edge diagnostic.

development_effect.note: The holder geometry is diagnostic evidence only until implemented and tested as a fixed candidate rule.
